frames.title: Google Docs Creative Brief Template for Video Ad Creation
frames.on_screen:
Google Docs document titled 'Copy of Creative Brief Template':
Sections shown:
- Notes: 'We are a company specialising in X and our target avatar is X'
- Direction:
  - 'You will always create 3 variations of the video, unless stated otherwise; you will only amend the audio hook (first sentences within a creative)'
  - 'You will end up with 3x creative assets: Hook 1 & Body, Hook 2 & Body, Hook 3 & Body'
  - Guidelines on finding B-roll content, relevant concepts, and cutting pauses longer than 2 seconds.
- Captions: 'FONT: Should be Proxima Nova SemiBold - White - Black Stroke around 4px Size 14 Font'
frames.not_in_transcript: Detailed document tab outline on left (Notes, Direction, Captions, Safe Zone, Format, End Scene, Assets for B-Roll, Hooks, Script). Highlighted green note: 'This is to ensure that menu targets the right avatar, not to make mock/different avatars or target niches into one creative.'
